# Ustaad

> Ustaad (ustaad.ae) is a UAE private tutoring service, founded in 2015, offering live online 1-to-1 lessons for IGCSE, GCSE, A-Level, IB (MYP, DP SL/HL) and American curriculum (AP) students in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah and the Northern Emirates. Tutors are matched to the student's exam board (Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel, AQA, OCR, IB, College Board).

Every first lesson includes a free 15-minute orientation. Families book through the contact form or WhatsApp (+971 56 124 9005). Email: support@ustaad.ae.

## Curricula

- [IGCSE tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/igcse): Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel International GCSE, Years 9 to 11
- [GCSE tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/gcse): UK GCSE for AQA, Pearson Edexcel and OCR
- [A-Level tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/a-level): AS and A2 for Cambridge, Edexcel, AQA and OCR
- [IB MYP tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/myp): IB Middle Years Programme
- [IB DP SL tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/dp-sl): IB Diploma Standard Level
- [IB DP HL tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/dp-hl): IB Diploma Higher Level
- [AP tutoring](https://ustaad.ae/ap): Advanced Placement courses and exam prep
- [British curriculum](https://ustaad.ae/british-curriculum): overview of the British pathway in the UAE
- [IB curriculum](https://ustaad.ae/ib-curriculum): overview of the IB pathway
- [American curriculum](https://ustaad.ae/american-curriculum): middle school, high school and AP
